name: Barrister Asaduzzaman Fuaad
contribution: As general secretary of AB Party, he contested the Barishal-3 constituency in the 12 February 2026 parliamentary election. His campaign drew national attention after he appealed on social media for public financial support rather than relying only on conventional party funding.
context: The 2026 election was held during Bangladesh's transition from interim rule after the 2024 uprising. Fuaad's campaign in the riverine Babuganj–Muladi constituency combined AB Party's reform-oriented platform with a public discussion of campaign costs, donation records, and electoral accountability.
impact: His campaign made small-party election finance part of the public conversation. Reports described donations arriving through mobile financial services and bank transfers after his appeal, while Fuaad said the records could be reviewed by election or government regulators. He also called for an election environment in which voters could choose without fear.
highlight: AB Party's general secretary and a 2026 candidate who used a public donation appeal to discuss election finance.
seoTitle: Asaduzzaman Fuaad: AB Party General Secretary and 2026 Candidate
seoDescription: Learn about Asaduzzaman Fuaad, AB Party general secretary, his Barishal-3 candidacy, public campaign-funding appeal, and election reform politics.
shortAnswer: Asaduzzaman Fuaad is the general secretary of AB Party and its Barishal-3 candidate in Bangladesh's 2026 parliamentary election.

faq.question: What constituency did Asaduzzaman Fuaad contest in 2026?
faq.answer: He contested Barishal-3, covering the Babuganj and Muladi areas, as an AB Party candidate in the 12 February 2026 parliamentary election.

faq.question: Why did Fuaad's campaign receive attention?
faq.answer: He publicly appealed to supporters for election funds through social media, prompting reporting about small-party campaign finance, donation records, and the legal spending limit.
